releaseNotes: 🚀 Lightning Fast Dashboard: Your dashboard metrics now load instantly and use significantly less internet data.
💾 Smart Data Caching: Navigating between tabs is incredibly smooth! The app now intelligently remembers your listings.
📸 Anti-Screenshot Protection: You can now toggle a setting in your Profile to block screenshots or screen-recordings.
🌐 Offline Awareness: A sleek new 'No internet connection' banner floats at the top if you lose cell signal.
📱 Smarter App Updates: Fixed updater caching logic.
🔒 Fortified Cloud Security: Strengthened database rules for strict privacy.
